scope: Three original editable SVG illustrations for the About story. No runtime assets or supplied civica identity assets changed.

assets.creator: civica.uk project; Codex-assisted original SVG markup
assets.licence: MIT, original repository documentation artwork under LICENSE
assets.provenance: Original flat vector geometry authored in this repository. No external artwork, stock photograph, screenshot, government identity path, supplied civica logo geometry or font file copied.
assets.purpose: Explain the difference between equally weighted small panels and grouped information with clear hierarchy.
assets.classification: Explanatory schematic, not a Home Assistant screenshot or evidence of deployed behaviour
assets.background: Opaque #F3F6F9 light canvas inside the SVG; suitable on a light or dark surrounding page without changing the asset. Fixed Civic Cobalt illustration colours do not encode device state or follow the selected theme.
assets.caption: Illustration, not a Home Assistant screenshot. The left arrangement gives many small details similar weight. The right groups related information, with a clear heading, a reading and one action in each row. This explains a design intention; it is not a measured usability result.

alternative_text_decision.reason: The complete adjacent figcaption states the meaning, values and limitations, so the embedded image is redundant. Keep the figcaption whenever using empty alt.
alternative_text_decision.standalone_informative_alt: Two schematic information arrangements: crowded tiles on the left and three grouped rows on the right.
alternative_text_decision.standalone_svg_accessibility: SVG role=img references its title and description. All internal shapes are non-interactive.
alternative_text_decision.text_alternative: Illustration, not a Home Assistant screenshot. The left arrangement gives many small details similar weight. The right groups related information, with a clear heading, a reading and one action in each row. This explains a design intention; it is not a measured usability result.

local_decisions: HTML carries the full explanation; no vital small labels are embedded in the artwork.
Only the detail illustration includes large numeric text and simple plus/minus/action symbols; the full values and meanings are repeated in HTML.
Functional control boundaries use ink strokes; other flat objects have no ornamental outlines, texture, gradients or 3D effects.
Objects and rooms are invented; no people, personal data, actual household layout or stereotype-dependent role is depicted.

verification.source_checks: XML parse, explicit dimensions/viewBox, at most six flat colours, no scripts, embedded raster, external dependencies, animation, filters or gradients.
verification.render_checks: Rendered with isolated local Playwright Chromium headless-shell build 1243 at 992px and 320px viewports; images displayed at 960px and 288px. No horizontal overflow recorded. All three images and text were visually inspected at both sizes.
verification.context_checks: Visually inspected 320px dark-surround, grayscale and images-omitted versions. Objects, groupings and 25%/40% distinction remain understandable; complete captions preserve meaning when images are omitted.
limitations: Local artwork inspection only; no live Home Assistant, end-user usability test or assistive-technology certification is claimed.
Grayscale was reviewed as a loss-of-colour check; this is not a simulation of every colour-vision deficiency.
Final About-page layout and screen-reader reading order need integration review after the figures are inserted.
